name: Visual / Spatial Room

aspectSystem.activationConcept: The user activates an in-world mechanism to magically transform the room into a selected aspect.

aspects.description: The default learning space for visual and spatial knowledge.

aspects.name: DVD Library
aspects.description: A transformed aspect of the Visual / Spatial Room focused on DVD and visual media collections.

aspects.name: Art Gallery
aspects.description: A future aspect for images, art, and visual references.
